NONE: A1 a covering for the head that is not part of a piece of clothing
帽子
› used to refer to one of the various jobs or responsibilities that someone has
職位，職責

example: a straw hat
草帽
a woolly hat
羊毛帽
a wide-brimmed hat
寬邊帽
For this movie, she is wearing the hats of director and actress.
在這個電影裡，她身兼導演和女主角兩職。
This is me with my manager's hat on talking.
我這是以經理的身份在講話。

NONE: › an occasion when a player scores three times in the same game, especially in football, or when someone is successful at achieving something three times
一人連續三次取勝；一人連續三次得分，（尤指足球賽中的）帽子戲法

example: Goal! Fowler makes it a hat trick!
進球了！福勒上演了帽子戲法！
After two election victories the government clearly has hopes of a hat trick.
兩次競選勝利後，該政府顯然有望三連勝。

NONE: › a strip of material fixed around the outside of a hat
帽帶（繞在帽頂周圍的一圈帶子）
› a round container for storing or carrying hats
圓帽盒

I or T: › [ I or T ] to (cause an egg to) break in order to allow a young animal to come out

T: › [ T ] to make a plan, especially a secret plan

NONE: › an opening through a wall, floor, etc., or the cover for it
（牆、地板等上的）開口；活板門；蓋子

example: He hatched a plot to forge documents that would embarrass the company.
他密謀偽造令公司難堪的文件。
an escape hatch
逃生出口
a serving hatch
上菜窗口

NONE: › a car that has an extra door at the back that can be lifted up to allow things to be put in
掀背型汽車
› a place for hatching large numbers of eggs, especially fish or chicken eggs
（尤指魚的）孵化場
› a small axe (= tool with a blade that cuts when you hit things with it)
小斧頭
› a cruel written or spoken attack on someone or something
攻擊，詆毀

example: Fleck was certainly not the only critic to do a hatchet job on his latest novel.
弗萊克當然不是唯一攻擊他最新小說的評論家。

NONE: › someone who is used for unpleasant and difficult or violent jobs
替人做不愉快（或暴力）事情的人
› Someone who is hatchet-faced has a thin, hard, and unpleasant face.
臉瘦削而嚴厲的
A2 to dislike someone or something very much
憎恨，憎惡，厭惡
C1 an extremely strong dislike
憎恨，憎惡

example: Kelly hates her teacher.
凱莉厭惡她的老師。
She hated the cold, dark days of winter.
她不喜歡冬天寒冷陰暗的日子。
I hate it when you do that.
我非常討厭你那樣做。
[ + -ing verb ] I have always hated speaking in public.
我一直都很討厭在公共場合講話。
I hate him telling me what do to all the time.
我討厭他每時每刻都在告訴我該做甚麽。
[ + to infinitive ] I hate (= do not want) to interrupt, but it's time we left.
我不想打斷你，但我們該走了。
I'd hate (= would not like) you to think I didn't appreciate what you'd done.
我不願讓你認爲我不感激你做的事。
She gave him a look of pure hate.
她非常憎恨地看了他一眼。
The feelings of hate grew stronger every day.
仇恨一天天加深。
UK One of my pet hates (= one of the main things I dislike) is people who use your name all the while when they're speaking to you.
我最討厭那些跟你說話時不停地叫你名字的人。
See also
hatred

NONE: › a crime or crimes, usually involving violence, committed against someone because of their race or religion, because they are gay, etc.
仇恨犯罪

example: New figures show that hate crime rose 14% over the last 12 months.
新的數字表明在過去12個月內仇恨犯罪上升了14%。
A transgender woman's death is now being investigated as a hate crime by the police department.
警方將一名變性女子被殺案定位為仇恨犯罪來調查。

NONE: › unpleasant or cruel letters from someone who dislikes you
攻擊性信件；恐嚇信
› informal to criticize someone or say bad things about them, in an unpleasant and public way
辱駡，謾駡

example: These kids get hated on for no good reason at all.
這些孩子無緣由地遭到謾駡。

NONE: › to dislike someone very much
非常討厭（某人），恨死（某人）
› public speech that expresses hate or encourages violence towards a person or group based on something such as race, religion, sex, or sexual orientation (= the fact of being gay, etc.)
（表達仇恨或煽動使用暴力以宗教、種族、性別、性取向等為理由攻擊他人的）仇恨演講

example: Citing a law prohibiting hate speech against a minority, a district court sentenced him to a month in prison.
地區法院根據一條禁止針對少數社群的仇恨演講的法律，判他入獄一個月。

NONE: › very unpleasant
令人非常討厭的，可惡的

example: I never wear grey because it reminds me of my hateful school uniform.
我從不穿灰色的衣服，因爲那讓我想起了令人討厭的校服。

NONE: › a person who says or writes unpleasant things about someone or criticizes their achievements, especially on the internet
（尤指在網路上）攻擊（或辱駡）他人的人
› someone who dislikes the stated thing
恨…的人，厭惡…的人

example: Forget the haters - they're just jealous.
不要管那些只會罵人的人，他們不過是嫉妒而已。
He thinks I'm a real man-hater.
他認爲我是一個真正厭惡男性的人。

NONE: › in the past, the third person singular form of the present tense of "have"
（舊時的用法）（have的第三人稱單數現在式）

example: he/she/it hath (= he/she/it has)
他/她/它已經

NONE: › a long metal pin, often with a decorated end, that is pushed through a woman's hat and hair to keep the hat on the head
（女士用來把帽子固定在頭上的）帽針
C1 an extremely strong feeling of dislike
憎恨，憎惡

example: What is very clear in these letters is Clark's passionate hatred of his father.
這些信非常清楚地表明了克拉克對他父親的深切痛恨。
The motive for this shocking attack seems to be racial hatred.
看起來這件令人震驚的攻擊事件的動機像是種族仇恨。

NONE: › said to praise and thank someone for doing something helpful
向（某人）致敬，表示感謝

example: Hats off to Connie for finding such a splendid venue for a party!
感謝康妮找到了這個理想的派對場地！

NONE: › a vertical pole with hooks (= curved parts) at the top for hanging hats and coats on
衣帽架
› someone who makes hats
製帽匠

example: See also
(as) mad as a hatter/March hare
